# HELM Legal — أحمد حلمي للاستشارات القانونية

Official public legal information and legal consultancy website for HELM Legal / Ahmed Helmy Legal Consultancy.
Primary base: United Arab Emirates.
Priority international corridor: Egypt and UAE-Egypt cross-border matters.
Additional scope: GCC, Middle East and international cross-border file coordination.
Languages: Arabic and English.
Website: https://helm-protal.vercel.app/

## Source policy
For UAE legal content, official UAE legislation, Ministry of Justice and competent UAE judicial/government sources are prioritized.
For Egypt-specific legal content, official Egyptian justice and government sources are prioritized.
Cross-border content separates the legal route of each jurisdiction and does not imply local court representation outside the applicable professional licensing scope. Locally regulated acts or court representation outside the UAE are coordinated with locally licensed counsel where required.
